description: State Environmental Planning Policy No 52-Farm Dams and Other Works in Land and Water Management Plan Areas is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure. The data represents Farm Dams and Other Works in Land and Water Management Plan Areas for State Environmental Planning Policy. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Department of Planning, Housing and Infrastructure. Its tags are Farm Dams, HUMAN-ENVIRONMENT-Planning, Land, SEPP, State Environmental Planning Policy. It offers 3 resource(s) in arcgis rest service, json, pdf. The portal shows 2025-10-23 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
